note: Scripture is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), read offline from the bundled owb-am-b.json.gz (founder decision 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere). Every quotation was re-quoted from it by script, replacing the earlier 1962 UBS / translator-rendered wording; a `mined` row means every quoted fragment is an exact substring of that block and of the cited OWB verse(s).

Partial verses quote the shortest contiguous OWB span that carries the English clause, without ellipses: Luke 14:21b therefore keeps OWB's whole list (the poor, the crippled, the blind, the lame); 1 Corinthians 3's epigraph is 3:12 from «በወርቅ» joined to 3:13a, and chapter 3's inline list of building materials is OWB 3:12's own list. Quotation marks inside OWB verses are dropped; the file's «» enclose each quote.

Jeremiah 31:3b keeps OWB's feminine address (ወደድኩሽ, Israel as the virgin daughter) verbatim; the chapter is about Amy's own coming to faith. Mark 16:15a «ወደ ዓለም ሁሉ ሂዱ» is the verse's exact OWB opening. Chapter 3's later echo of the image follows OWB's «ገለባ» for stubble (was «አገዳ»).
The English epigraphs are simplified child paraphrases ("— from Psalm 139"), cited `— ከ<Book> <chapter>`.

No Amharic full or teen edition of this life exists yet, so names follow the shipped am corpus: ኤሚ ካርማይክል, ዶህናቩር, አማ (brave-for-god.am, women-who-moved-heaven-2.am), ኬዝዊክ, ኩዌከር, የቻይና የውስጥ ሚስዮን, ሴይሎን, ታሚል.
